create_draft_envelope.description: Prepare a draft envelope with your documents and signers. The draft is not sent yet; use 'Send envelope' when it is ready.
create_draft_envelope.name: create_draft_envelope

parameters.description: The subject line signers see in the email asking them to sign (up to 100 characters).
parameters.name: email_subject

parameters.description: The documents to be signed. Each document needs its file contents as Base64 text, a name, and an ID you choose (for example "1"). Anything that is not a PDF also needs its file extension.
parameters.name: documents

documentId.description: A unique ID you choose, e.g. '1'.

fileExtension.description: File type, e.g. 'docx'. Required for anything that is not a PDF.

parameters.description: Who should receive the envelope. Put the people who must sign under 'signers', each with a name, email, and a unique recipient ID you choose (for example "1").
parameters.name: recipients

signers.description: The people who need to sign.

envelope_id.description: ID of the new draft envelope.

download_documents.description: Download an envelope's documents as one PDF, with every signature added so far, for a later step to save, attach or send. Once everyone has signed, this is the finished copy.
download_documents.name: download_documents

parameters.description: The ID of the envelope whose documents to download.
parameters.name: envelope_id

parameters.description: Add DocuSign's certificate of completion, which records who signed and when, at the end of the PDF.
parameters.name: include_certificate

document_ref.description: The downloaded PDF, for steps that take a file.

envelope_id.description: The envelope the documents came from.

get_envelope_recipients.description: See who an envelope went to and where each signer is: sent, delivered (opened), signed (completed) or declined, with when. A signer whose turn in the signing order has not come yet shows as created.
get_envelope_recipients.name: get_envelope_recipients

parameters.description: The ID of the envelope to check.
parameters.name: envelope_id

carbon_copies.description: People who get a copy but don't sign.

signers.description: Each person who signs, in order.

role_name.description: The template role they fill, if any.

routing_order.description: Their turn in the signing order.

sent_at.description: When it was sent to them.

status.description: sent (asked to sign, not opened yet), delivered (opened, not signed yet), completed (signed), declined, or created: a signer whose turn has not come yet, because someone earlier in the signing order has still to sign. DocuSign has not emailed them yet.

get_envelope_status.description: Check where an envelope is in the signing process (for example sent, delivered, or completed).
get_envelope_status.display_str_template: Get the status of DocuSign envelope {envelope_id}.
get_envelope_status.name: get_envelope_status

parameters.description: The ID of the envelope to check.
parameters.name: envelope_id

status.description: The current status of the envelope.

get_form_data.description: Read what the signers filled in on an envelope's fields, such as a company name, an address or a choice from a list, to use in later steps. Your DocuSign account must let senders download form data, a sending setting an admin can turn on.
get_form_data.display_str_template: Get the form data of envelope {envelope_id}.
get_form_data.name: get_form_data

parameters.description: The ID of the envelope to read, such as the one 'Envelope completed' starts a run with.
parameters.name: envelope_id

email_subject.description: The subject of the signing email.

envelope_id.description: The envelope the fields are on.

field_values.description: The same fields by name, so a later step can use one directly, such as field_values.Company.

fields.description: Every field on the envelope, with what was filled in.

name.description: The field's name in the document.

fields.description: The fields this person filled in, each with a name and value.

status.description: The envelope's status, such as sent or completed.

list_envelopes.description: List the documents you have sent for signature (DocuSign calls these envelopes), newest first. You can narrow the list by status or by when the envelope last changed. Beta: it can also list only the envelopes still waiting to be signed that were sent at least so many days ago, and each envelope says how many days it has waited and who has still to sign.
list_envelopes.name: list_envelopes

parameters.description: Only show envelopes with this status. Leave blank to include every status. Beta: 'Waiting to be signed' (waiting) covers every envelope that is out for signature, whether or not a signer has opened it yet; Sent and Delivered each cover only half of them.
parameters.name: status

options.label: Waiting to be signed: sent or opened (beta)

parameters.description: Only show envelopes whose status changed on or after this date. Leave blank to look back over the last 90 days, or far enough to cover 'Sent at least this many days ago' when that is filled in (at least a year).
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.description: The maximum number of envelopes to return (up to 1000). Leave blank for every matching envelope DocuSign gives in one answer; DocuSign sets that number, and it is never more than 1000.
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: Beta. Only show envelopes that were sent this many days ago or longer, such as 3 for ones that have been out for three days or more. Use it with the status 'Waiting to be signed' to find the envelopes to chase. Drafts, which were never sent, are left out. Leave blank to include envelopes of any age.
parameters.display_name: Sent at least this many days ago
parameters.name: sent_at_least_days_ago

completedDateTime.description: When the last signer finished. Empty until it is completed.

days_waiting.description: Beta. How many whole days it has been out for signature: from when it was sent until now, or until it was completed. 0 for a draft.

emailSubject.description: The subject the signers were emailed, usually the contract's name.

sentDateTime.description: When it was sent for signing.

sent_display.description: Beta. The day it was sent as a person writes it, such as Jul 15, 2026. Blank for a draft.

status.description: Where it is: sent, delivered, signed, completed, declined, voided or created.

waiting_on.description: Beta. Who has still to sign, as text ready for a message: each person's name and email with commas between them, such as Ann Lee (ann@example.com), Bo Chen (bo@example.com). Blank unless the envelope is waiting to be signed.

list_templates.description: List the reusable envelope templates in your DocuSign account, optionally filtered by name.
list_templates.name: list_templates

parameters.description: Only show templates whose name contains this text (up to 48 characters). Leave blank to list all templates.
parameters.name: search_text

send_envelope.description: Send a draft envelope to its recipients for signature.
send_envelope.name: send_envelope

parameters.description: The ID of the draft envelope to send.
parameters.name: envelope_id

send_from_template.description: Send a document for signature using one of your DocuSign templates, filling each of its roles (such as Client or Manager) with a person. It goes to them straight away.
send_from_template.name: send_from_template

parameters.description: The template to send. Pick one, or use one from an earlier step.
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.description: Who fills each role in the template. Give each person the role's name exactly as the template has it, their name and their email.
parameters.name: signers

role_name.description: The role in the template, e.g. 'Client'.

parameters.description: The subject of the email asking them to sign (up to 100 characters). Leave blank to use the template's.
parameters.name: email_subject

envelope_id.description: ID of the envelope that was sent.

send_reminder.description: Email the signing request again to the people an envelope is still waiting on, with their own link to sign. Only the people whose turn it is are emailed: not those who already signed, and not those waiting for someone earlier in the signing order. If nobody is being asked to sign, such as on a finished envelope, nothing is sent and the step says so.
send_reminder.name: send_reminder

parameters.description: The ID of the envelope to send reminders for, such as the envelopeId of one that 'List envelopes' found.
parameters.name: envelope_id

envelope_id.description: The envelope the reminder was for.

reminded.description: true when DocuSign emailed at least one signer again; false when nobody was being asked to sign, so nothing was sent.

reminded_text.description: The same people as text ready for a message, such as Ann Lee (ann@example.com), Bo Chen (bo@example.com). Blank when nobody was reminded.

void_envelope.description: Cancel an envelope that has already been sent so it can no longer be signed. You must give a reason. Only envelopes that are still in progress can be cancelled, not drafts, and not envelopes everyone has already signed.
void_envelope.name: void_envelope

parameters.description: The ID of the envelope to cancel.
parameters.name: envelope_id

parameters.description: Why the envelope is being cancelled (shown to recipients, up to 200 characters).

examples.label: Replaced
examples.value: Sent in error: a corrected version will follow.

parameters.name: void_reason

description: Send documents for signature, track envelope status, and manage templates in DocuSign.

docusign_envelope_completed_trigger.description: Runs when everyone has signed an envelope, with its ID and subject, ready for 'Download signed documents'. Envelopes already completed when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.email_subject: The subject of the signing email.
output.envelope_id: The envelope's ID, for the other DocuSign steps.
output.signers: Beta. Everyone who was asked to sign, in signing order: a list where each person has name, email, signed_at (when they signed, such as 2026-11-20T15:04:05.0000000Z, or blank if they haven't) and role (the role they sign as in a template, such as Candidate, or blank if none).
output.signers_text: Beta. Everyone who was asked to sign, one per line in signing order, such as 'Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>', ready to put in a message or an AI prompt. Empty if there were none.

parameters.description: Beta. Only start for envelopes whose email subject contains these words, such as Offer letter. Capital letters do not matter. Leave blank to start for every envelope.
parameters.name: subject_contains

docusign_envelope_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when an envelope is sent, opened by a signer, completed, declined or voided: pick one, or leave it blank for all five. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.completed_at: When the last person signed, if they have.
output.current_status: Its status now, which may have moved on since.
output.email_subject: The subject of the signing email.
output.envelope_id: The envelope's ID, for the other DocuSign steps.
output.signers: Beta. Everyone who was asked to sign, in signing order: a list where each person has name, email, signed_at (when they signed, such as 2026-11-20T15:04:05.0000000Z, or blank if they haven't) and role (the role they sign as in a template, such as Candidate, or blank if none).
output.signers_text: Beta. Everyone who was asked to sign, one per line in signing order, such as 'Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>', ready to put in a message or an AI prompt. Empty if there were none.
output.status: The status it reached: sent, delivered, completed, declined or voided.
output.voided_reason: Why it was voided, if it was.

parameters.description: Only start when an envelope reaches this status: sent, delivered (opened by a signer), completed, declined or voided. Leave blank to start for any of them.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Beta. Only start for envelopes whose email subject contains these words, such as Offer letter. Capital letters do not matter. Leave blank to start for every envelope.
parameters.name: subject_contains
